intent: A sliding lid for an open-top box: a flat rectangular top plate with a smaller rectangular lip on its underside that locates inside the box rim as a loose sliding fit. Plate prints top-face-down.

parts.description: Flat lid plate 80x50x2 with 74x44x2 locating lip

interfaces.description: Lip locates in the box rim

parts.engineering_rationale: no load-bearing features (locating lip is a sliding fit, no sustained load)
